protocol.javascript_id_policy: All protocol identifiers are uint64 JSON numbers. JavaScript and TypeScript SDKs must decode them losslessly as bigint (or validated decimal strings at their public boundary), and must not expose IEEE-754 number ids. Pairing request ids, revisions, timestamps, frame sequences, and reservation ids follow the same rule.
